title: Juicy Greek Shrimp Bake
description: A delicious, paleo-friendly Greek dish featuring succulent shrimp and a crispy, wood-fired crust. This kid-friendly recipe is perfect for a night in or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: for brushing shrimp and baking dish

instructions: Rinse the shrimp under cold water and pat dry with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, mix together the kapi, feta cheese, parsley, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and Greek seasoning.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the kapi mixture.
Line a baking dish with parchment paper and arrange the shrimp in a single layer.
Brush the top of the shrimp with the remaining olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Bake the shrimp in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until pink and cooked through.
Garnish with additional parsley and serve hot.
